explanation: It grew from the Dutch of settlers who reached the Cape from 1652, picking up words from Malay, Portuguese, Khoekhoe and Bantu languages. Afrikaans is Dutch for African.

claims.text: Afrikaans developed mainly from the Dutch spoken by settlers at the Cape.
Afrikaans did not grow mainly out of German, English or Portuguese.
Dutch East India Company settlers began arriving at the Cape in 1652.
Afrikaans took words from Malay, Portuguese, Khoekhoe and Bantu languages.
